title: Sivasakthi
desc: Sakthi, a police officer, befriends Siva, a smuggler, in order to gain his trust and get evidence against him. But soon, their friendship turns into a genuine one.

title: Pudhiya Mannargal
desc: The lives of a young group are turned upside down when they are coerced into joining the world of politics and making a difference.

title: Thoongathey Thambi Thoongathey
desc: Gopi, an unemployed graduate, falls in love with Padmini, the daughter of a rich businessman. Padmini finds Vinod, Gopi's lookalike, who turns out to be his brother.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

title: Villain
desc: Shiva, a bus conductor, robs the corrupt in order to fund an organisation that aids those with disabilities. To avoid detection and trial, he pretends to be his twin, who has disabilities.
